slot.brief: Given a substituted benzene (two groups with conflicting directives) in a figure, predict the major monosubstitution product.

stem: On nitration of the compound shown in the figure, which is the major product of monosubstitution?

verdicts.working: The starting compound is 1-bromo-3-nitrobenzene. The existing nitro group directs substitution meta; its only available meta position is C5, giving 1-bromo-3,5-dinitrobenzene.

working:
Br at C1 directs to C2, C4 and C6; $\text{NO}_2$ at C3 directs meta, to C1 and C5.\nC1 is occupied; the nitro group strongly disfavors substitution at its ortho/para sites C2, C4 and C6.\nSubstitution at C5 gives 1-bromo-3,5-dinitrobenzene.

Independent check: The starting compound is 1-bromo-3-nitrobenzene. The existing nitro group directs substitution meta; its only available meta position is C5, giving 1-bromo-3,5-dinitrobenzene.
solution: In 1-bromo-3-nitrobenzene, the existing $\text{NO}_2$ group directs nitration to the meta position; the available meta site is C5. Thus the product is 1-bromo-3,5-dinitrobenzene, (D).
